blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Protesters calling for the conviction of Vice President Sara Duterte gathered outside the Senate ahead of Friday’s impeachment trial proceedings. The protesters have been gathering along JW Diokno Boulevard since Sept. 29, but their numbers were noticeably higher on Friday, the 37th day of the trial. READ: VP Trial Day 37: BIR exec to finish testifying before Senate impeach court Groups joining the rally included Akbayan, Mamamayang Liberal or ML, Bayan, Magdalo Akbayan Youth, Tindig Pilipinas, among others In an interview with reporters, Akbayan president Rafaela David said they gathered to show the court, particularly the senator-judges, that […]...
